items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: Did he play with any other bands? No. No. No. Mostly with you through the ears? Mm-hmm.

ctx.x: He, he, he must got corroded the fingers because he quit playing. Yeah. He quit playing.
And Tommy. Yeah, well. I never have seen him with anybody else. Did he play with any other bands? No. No. No. Mostly with you through the ears? Mm-hmm. Where does he live in here?
He do, don't, he lives in there on St. Peter and the Villery. Mm-hmm.
